title: Over 3,000 Migrants Moved to New Port Reception Camp With Capacity for Just 1,700
detail: Police began transferring migrants from the El Trampolín and Benítez beach encampments to the new temporary reception camp on Ceuta port's Poniente dock early Friday, after Spain's National Court on Wednesday rejected a police union's bid to block the facility's opening. More than 3,000 people were moved but the camp holds only around 1,700, producing chaotic scenes as people rushed to secure places and police repeatedly intervened to enforce cordons; government sources characterised the overall operation as proceeding normally despite the tension. Officials revised their estimate of migrants still in Ceuta sharply upward to 9,000-10,000 — roughly double the previously cited 5,000 figure — with about 6,000 now in official facilities and 3,000-4,000 still on the streets or beaches. PP leader Miguel Tellado called Ceuta 'a city without law' fifty days after the crossing and demanded all migrants be returned to Morocco, while Sumar criticised police use of force against migrants during the transfer.

title: Moroccan Driver Arrested at Ceuta Port Trying to Smuggle Two Migrants Onto Algeciras Ferry
detail: National Police arrested a Moroccan man at Ceuta's port around 1:30pm Thursday as he attempted to board the Algeciras ferry with two undocumented migrants hidden in his vehicle. The arrest is the 61st made under 'Operación Senén,' the Interior Ministry's ongoing operation targeting smuggling networks that move migrants from Ceuta onto the Spanish mainland since the July 30-31 crossing.

title: Spain Announces Nations League Squad From Ceuta in Solidarity Gesture
detail: Spain men's national football coach Luis de la Fuente unveiled his squad for the upcoming Nations League fixtures in a video filmed in Ceuta alongside local residents, declaring 'this is Ceuta, this is Spain' in a show of solidarity with the enclave nearly two months into the migration crisis. Spain is set to debut its new two-star, World Cup-winning kit against England at Wembley on Sep 26.
